# What msiexec /i and then /x of examples/branded change on the machine.
# Written by TestMsiexecInstallsExamples with GO_MSI_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1.

[install]
+ dir {Installer}\{ProductCode}
+ dir {ProgramFiles}\Example
+ dir {ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent
+ file {Installer}\SourceHash{ProductCode}
+ file {Installer}\{ProductCode}\icon.ico = input icon.ico
+ file {ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent-service.exe = input agent-service.exe
+ file {ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent.conf = input agent.conf
+ file {ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent.exe = input agent.exe
+ file {ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\icon.ico = input icon.ico
+ key HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent
+ key HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode}
+ key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Example
+ key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Example\Agent
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [Description] = "Example Agent service"
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [DisplayName] = "Example Agent"
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [ErrorControl] = dword 1
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [FailureActions] = type 3 000000000000000000000000030000001400000001000000e803000001000000e803000001000000e8030000
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [ImagePath] = expand ""{ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent-service.exe""
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [ObjectName] = "LocalSystem"
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [Start] = dword 2
+ value HKLM\...\Services\ExampleAgent [Type] = dword 16
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [AuthorizedCDFPrefix] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Comments] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Contact] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [DisplayName] = "Example Agent"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [DisplayVersion] = "1.5.0"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [EstimatedSize] = <size>
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [HelpLink] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [HelpTelephone] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [InstallDate] = <date>
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [InstallLocation] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [InstallSource] = "{PackageDir}\"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Language] = dword 1033
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [ModifyPath] = expand "MsiExec.exe /I{ProductCode}"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Publisher] = "Example"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Readme] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Size] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [URLInfoAbout] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [URLUpdateInfo] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [UninstallString] = expand "MsiExec.exe /I{ProductCode}"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [VersionMajor] = dword 1
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [VersionMinor] = dword 5
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [Version] = dword 17104896
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{ProductCode} [WindowsInstaller] = dword 1
+ value HKLM\SOFTWARE\Example\Agent [Arguments] = multi ["run", "{ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent.conf"]
+ value HKLM\SOFTWARE\Example\Agent [] = "{ProgramFiles}\Example\Agent\agent.exe"

[uninstall]
